title: Apply global survivability continuity rule across Pen work
objective: Ensure every Pen handover, runtime claim, launch gate, deployment claim and future 72h survivability reference uses successful-continuity enforcement, not passive unattended waiting.
required_actions: Load global/SURVIVABILITY_CONTINUITY_RULE.md as canonical rule for all Pen processing.
Update bridge validation so 72h survivability requires continuous successful operation with telemetry, recovery, replay and escalation evidence.
Reject any handover or receipt that treats 72h as broken-but-untouched runtime.

Require survivability receipts to include start_time, end_time, heartbeat_count, incident_count, recovered_incident_count, unresolved_incidents, telemetry_gap_report, replay_result, recovery_result and final_classification.
Apply REAL/PARTIAL/MISSING/REJECTED classification exactly as defined in the global rule.
Add this rule to launch gate validation for production and runtime handovers.
Write receipt showing which validators, templates, workflows or processors were updated.
pass_condition: Future work cannot claim 72h survivability unless successful continuity is proven by receipts, telemetry, recovery/replay proof and operator brief evidence.
fail_condition: If the runtime is broken, silent, unrecovered, stalled, or merely left unattended, classify survivability as REJECTED or MISSING and escalate immediately.
